description: Replace the rows matching a SQL predicate with new documents, 1:1; the number of matched rows must equal the number of replacement documents. As with add, a row that omits its vector has it embedded from the text column (local model, no API key). Requires durable storage (not memory://).

documents.description: Replacement rows, as JSON objects keyed by column name (one per matched row).

predicate.description: SQL predicate selecting the rows to replace, e.g. "status = 'draft'".

name: infino_update_documents
title: Update documents in an Infino table
